sn8.1:1.2: Vaṅgīsa, the greatest poet of the Sangha, eulogizes his mentor (_upajjhāya_) Nigrodhakappa in his verses at [snp2.12]() and [thag21.1](). In several passages, including this one, he reflects on the struggles he faced in his path, showing a high degree of self-awareness and persistence.
sn8.1:1.5: “Dissatisfaction” (_anabhirati_) with his life of seclusion and celibacy.
